name: iam:PassRole + ecs:CreateCluster + ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition + ecs:RunTask
description: Create an ECS cluster, register a task definition with a privileged role, and run it on Fargate to execute attacker-controlled container commands with the role's permissions
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
Must be able to create ECS clusters
Must be able to register new task definitions
Must be able to run tasks on the cluster

additional.description: Find VPCs for Fargate network configuration
Find subnets for Fargate network configuration

admin: A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
lateral: A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com

references.title: Weaponizing AWS ECS Task Definitions to Steal Credentials From Running Containers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the ECS task (must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for ECS cluster and task deployment

options.name: CLUSTER_NAME
options.description: Name for the new ECS cluster to create

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for Fargate network configuration (will auto-detect from default VPC if not specified)

options.name: CONTAINER_IMAGE
options.description: Container image to use for the task

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete cluster and deregister task definition after execution

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via ECS task container command
